prompt_text:
Match this appearance phrase against ALL anonymous person tiles in the image(s): "the person with a red feathered headpiece and a dark patterned jacket"
Every labeled tile is one different person from the same video; its two crops are held-out views. Labels and tile order do not reveal the intended target. A phrase may match none, one, or several people. Include ALL people who visibly satisfy the whole phrase in matches. Include in uncertain any plausible person for whom the views do not resolve an attribute, instead of assuming that person is a non-match. Do not pick a best match when several fit. A location or action does not distinguish appearance. Omitted labels mean clear non-matches.
Return {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"brief visual explanation"}. Valid labels: ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P08"].

message.content: {"matches":["P05"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"Only P05 has a red feathered headpiece (visible in both crops) and a dark patterned jacket. All other individuals wear similar dark patterned jackets but lack the red feathered headpiece. The headpiece is clearly red and feathery in P05's images, matching the description exactly."}

parsed.reason: Only P05 has a red feathered headpiece (visible in both crops) and a dark patterned jacket. All other individuals wear similar dark patterned jackets but lack the red feathered headpiece. The headpiece is clearly red and feathery in P05's images, matching the description exactly.
